856-2511-4321-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2511-4321-8347.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.

880-6529-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-8105-8293.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-8105-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

574-1829-1981-2415.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1829-1981-2415.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

789-4279-4699--216.easyPrerequisites:

Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-4279-4699--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.

Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2724-4006-7843.description:
Activate Elrond by paying {5}{U}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Hushbringer.
Repeat each turn.

Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.

Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

277-5702-7401.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
277-5702-7401.notablePrerequisites: At least half of the basic lands in your library are Forests.
277-5702-7401.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
When the Springbloom Druid token enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a land, then search your library for a basic Forest and another basic land and put them onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Forest and other basic land enter, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Resolve both Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the basic lands.
Holding priority, activate both lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
Repeat from step 3 until your library contains no basic lands.
277-5702-7401.notes: You can perform this combo if half the basic lands in your library aren't Forests, but you won't be able to grab all basic lands unless you supplement {G} to compensate. While you will put all basic lands onto the battlefield, you'll have to sacrifice half of them to continue the combo. This won't affect how many landfall triggers, ETB triggers and creature tokens you get however.

3259-6968-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.

If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

Repeat.

2653-4693-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
2653-4693-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger that many times.
Resolve all Nissa triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

277-880-4488.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.

Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.

Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying its mana cost.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4772-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4772-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.

Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
Repeat from step 3.

567-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.

When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Lightning-Rig Crew.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Human Soldiers, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Human Soldiers, adding {3}.
Repeat.

239-302-1636-3825-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
At most {1} plus two mana of any two different colors available, plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
239-302-1636-3825-5072.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Cast Sliver Grandmother from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Sliver Grandmother enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priortiy, activate Sliver Gravemother by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Activate Sliver Gravemother by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
Choose not to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, causing each player to discard a card.
Activate Sliver Gravemother's encore ability by paying {5} and exiling it.
Choose to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from exile.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, creating a token copy of it for each opponent you have.
When the Sliver Gravemother tokens enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate the Sliver Gravemother tokens by tapping them, adding at least three mana of any color(s).
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Repeat from step 15 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

Resolve the Out of Time trigger, untapping all creatures.
